# UI/UX Pro Max: opinionated end-to-end interface design across 10 stacks

Curated by Skill Harbor — @pixel-process-ug's UI/UX Pro Max skill: an opinionated, end-to-end interface design system with a non-negotiable priority hierarchy — Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA minimum, 4.5:1 contrast, keyboard navigation, ARIA, reduced-motion) before touch targets (44x44px) before performance (WebP/AVIF, CLS/LCP/FID budgets, font-display swap) before style before layout. It walks five phases with explicit STOP-and-confirm gates: requirements gathering, style selection via context decision tables (SaaS → Minimalism/Swiss/Material 3, portfolio → Brutalism/Maximalism/Glassmorphism, e-commerce, mobile, landing, enterprise, health, finance, kids, luxury), color and typography (per-product palette categories with counts, semantic color tokens, dark-mode remap rules, 10 font pairings, type scale), UX guidelines (navigation, forms, feedback, content layout, mobile rules — 22 numbered rules), and implementation (chart-type decision table by data relationship, patterns for 10 stacks: React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, plain HTML/CSS, 3-layer design-token architecture). Finishes with a quick-wins checklist and an anti-patterns table (opacity for disabled text, placeholder-only labels, raw hex in components, modal-on-modal).
